name: Relative clauses
note: who for people, which for things, that for either (in defining clauses), whose for possession, where for places. You can drop the pronoun when it is the object of the clause (the film (that) I saw). Don't use what as a relative pronoun.

questions.q: ______ are you from? Japan.
I like all Russian novelists, ______ Tolstoy.
Mont Blanc, ______ we visited last summer, is the highest mountain in Europe.
questions.x: which — for things and animals. Here it refers back to the whole idea before the comma.

questions.q: Gentlemen, from ______ we expect politeness, ought not to lose their tempers.
"Mary's family is very rich." "Well, I knew her uncle was very ______ ."
My brother, ______ lives in Iceland, is coming to visit us.
I'm looking for something with ______ I can clean the board.
Well, I think you ought to speak to that man ______ standing with a notebook in front of the car.
questions.fs: Well, I think you ought to speak to that man who's standing with a notebook in front of the car.

questions.q: I strongly recommend you make a checklist of points to consider ______ deciding which method of payment to accept.
questions.fs: I strongly recommend you make a checklist of points to consider when deciding which method of payment to accept.

questions.q: Men ______ work is good receive high wages.
The film star gave a party ______ cost $10.000.
Your information, for ______ I'm grateful, is very helpful.
She's ______ than her sister.
That is the hotel ______ I stayed at.
He's the man ______ Anna loves.
That's another way of saying it. I'm talking about the car ______ parked over there.
questions.fs: That's another way of saying it. I'm talking about the car that's parked over there.

questions.q: After a heart attack, he needed a major surgery, but fortunately the operation was ______ .
The book ______ is on the table is mine.
I think you will see that this is the best museum ______ you can find in the town.
questions.fs: I think you will see that this is the best museum that you can find in the town.
questions.x: that — for people or things in a defining clause (no commas).

questions.q: Trains in London are more crowded ______ in Paris.
Was Joan's party better ______ Maria's?
His wife, ______ lives in Paris, is a fashion model.
______ do you think would have a car like that?
questions.fs: Who do you think would have a car like that?
questions.x: that — for people or things in a defining clause (no commas).

questions.q: It's our anniversary today. We've been ______ for fifteen years.
I cook food for a restaurant. I'm a(n) ______ .
She was very ill and ______ died, but fortunately, she got better.
Jessica's as tall ______ her mother.
Bryan Adams is the singer ______ songs I like best.
I serve you drinks on a plane flight. I'm a ______ .
That's the house ______ I was born.
Do you like the people ______ Sarah invited to her party?
I called Tom at 10.00 in the morning, but he was ______ in bed.
He's ______ boy in the class.
questions.x: Superlative: the + …est / most … — one out of three or more.

questions.q: Sarah's English is getting better. She ______ a lot of English since she ______ here.
Who is the ______ man in the world?
A thermostat is something ______ controls temperatures.
Here are the letters ______ arrived this morning.
The police want to find out ______ drove the red car into the shop window.
questions.fs: The police want to find out who drove the red car into the shop window.

questions.q: I don't like food ______ is very spicy.
"I hate ironing." "Me, ______ . It's so boring."
The man ______ car was stolen phoned the police.
In my job I wear the latest fashions. I'm a(n) ______ .
Is there a time ______ we can discus this problem?
______ is that sitting over there in the corner?
questions.fs: Who is that sitting over there in the corner?

questions.q: People ______ study the weather are called meteorologists.
questions.x: that — for people or things in a defining clause (no commas).

questions.q: The disco was so ______ that you couldn't hear yourself speak.
Where is the woman ______ ordered the fish.
"I'm bored with this lesson!" "I know, I'm really ______ with it, too!"
He's my sister's son. He's my ______ .
Those are old cars ______ only take leaded petrol.
Are you as tall ______ your brother?
The factory ______ he works is closing down.
David can go to bed now. He ______ his homework.
I bought the coat ______ was in the shop window.
The Red Lion is the pub ______ we met for a drink.
I like it ______ it rains.
questions.fs: I like it when it rains.

questions.q: Miss Snow, ______ you met at the theatre, is my classmate.
I like photographs ______ are in black and white.
That's the dictionary ______ Bill gave me for my birthday.
The grass, ______ I cut every week, seems to grow very quickly.
questions.fs: The grass, which I cut every week, seems to grow very quickly.

questions.q: There is a new television programme called: ' ______ wants to be a millionaire?'.
questions.fs: There is a new television programme called: 'Who wants to be a millionaire?'.

questions.q: That's interesting. We are talking about the car ______ has a red roof.
questions.fs: That's interesting. We are talking about the car that has a red roof.
questions.x: that — for people or things in a defining clause (no commas).

questions.q: You're reading the book ______ I wanted to read.
Rome was hotter ______ I expected.
Mustafa Kemal, ______ was born in 1881, became the first President of Turkey on October 29th, 1923.
Everything is ______ in my country.
"Wasn't that film wonderful!" "Yes, it was ______ ."
What's the name of the woman ______ was wearing the gold dress?
I try to lead a ______ lifestyle - lots of exercises, fruit, and no junk food.
They have a very large house round ______ there are some lovely gardens.
questions.fs: They have a very large house round which there are some lovely gardens.

questions.q: The wedding was wonderful. The ______ looked beautiful, and the ______ was very handsome.
The person in the house next to mine knows someone ______ met the Queen.
questions.fs: The person in the house next to mine knows someone who met the Queen.

questions.q: Alison ______ in Chicago, but she would like to go there one day.
Venice is a very ______ city. A lot of people go there on honeymoon.
"Ann's bedroom's really untidy again!" "Is it? I told her it was ______ yesterday, and she promised to clean it."
I'm looking at the photograph ______ you sent me with your letter.
questions.fs: I'm looking at the photograph which you sent me with your letter.

questions.q: I didn't like that city at all. The streets were so ______ and the air was so ______ .
Yes, it's the best car ______ I've ever had. Why do you ask?
questions.fs: Yes, it's the best car that I've ever had. Why do you ask?

questions.q: "What ______ New York like?" "It's really exciting!"
Excuse me but shouldn't you say to ______ does that car belong?
questions.fs: Excuse me but shouldn't you say to whom does that car belong?

questions.q: Oh no! It's a traffic warden putting a parking ticket on my car and I haven't any money to pay the fine ______ I'll have to pay.
questions.fs: Oh no! It's a traffic warden putting a parking ticket on my car and I haven't any money to pay the fine which I'll have to pay.

questions.q: Before you can get a credit card, you have to provide a lot of ______ details.
The man ______ you met at the party was a famous film star.
______ does that car belong to?
questions.fs: Who does that car belong to?

questions.q: Kate is very fussy about food. She ______ eats pasta and crisps.
They are the policemen ______ caught the thief.
Mike and Jack ______ here five months ago. They ______ in this city for five months.
